title: Wrong Hands
description: A driver account has no business creating new shipments — that's a customer, dispatcher, or admin action. Confirm the role gate on booking creation actually excludes drivers.
successCondition: POST /api/booking as a logged-in driver-role account, with an otherwise valid origin/destination/package body, returns 403 with error.code FORBIDDEN.
hints: Register a driver-role account with POST /api/auth/register to get a driver token to test with.
The allowed roles for this route are exactly customer, dispatcher, and admin — driver is the one role deliberately left out.
